title: ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management Systems: Verified Measurement Credential Alignment
context: 2026-08-27 engine cycle -- growing regulatory demand for ISO/IEC 42001 certification with the EU AI Act's August 2026 application deadline driving audit volume
body: ISO/IEC 42001 requires organisations to establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an AI management system. The standard demands evidence of AI system monitoring — but does not specify how. The Council of AI verified measurement credential fills this gap: for each AI system under management, the credential provides a signed, auditable record of (1) which measurement boards the system has passed, (2) the per-model scores on those boards, (3) the cryptographic hash of the board configuration used, and (4) a timestamped attestation chain. An ISO 42001 auditor reviewing Clause 9 (performance evaluation) can verify these records without access to internal infrastructure — the public key validates the signature, the board hash confirms the test configuration, and the scores provide quantitative evidence of ongoing monitoring. This alignment turns ISO 42001 from a document-heavy audit framework into a lightweight, continuously verifiable oversight mechanism. The Council maintains a free mapping document for auditors: councilofai.org/iso42001-mapping.
references: Council of AI Verified Measurement Credential standard
